sources.name: Margarita
sources.method: Shake with ice and strain over ice or serve straight up.
sources.glass: Cocktail glass or rocks glass, optional salt rim
steps: If desired, prepare the salt rim before filling the glass.
Shake tequila, triple sec, and lime juice with ice.
Strain into a cocktail glass or over ice in a rocks glass.
Garnish with a lime wedge if desired.

sources.name: Old Fashioned
sources.method: Muddle sugar, bitters, and orange; add ice and whiskey.
steps: Put sugar, bitters, and orange slice in the glass and muddle.
Add ice and rye whiskey.
Finish with a maraschino cherry and orange slice.

sources.name: Espresso Martini
sources.method: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain.
steps: Pour vodka, coffee liqueur, and espresso into a shaker.
Shake well with ice.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass and garnish with 3 coffee beans.

sources.name: Mojito
sources.method: Muddle, add ice and rum, stir, then top with soda.
steps: Muddle lime, sugar, and mint in the glass.
Add ice and rum and stir.
Top with club soda and garnish with a mint sprig.

sources.name: Negroni
sources.method: Build in the glass over ice.
steps: Add ice to an old-fashioned glass.
Pour gin, Campari, and sweet red vermouth into the glass.
Garnish with an orange slice and serve.

sources.name: Manhattan
sources.method: Stir with ice and strain.
steps: Combine whiskey, vermouth, and bitters with ice.
Stir and strain into a cocktail glass.
Garnish with a cherry.

sources.name: Martini
sources.method: Stir with ice and strain.
steps: Chill the glass.
Stir gin and dry vermouth with ice.
Strain into the chilled cocktail glass and garnish with an olive or lemon peel.

sources.name: Daiquiri
sources.method: Shake with ice and serve chilled.
steps: Combine white rum, lime juice, and gomme syrup with ice.
Shake and serve chilled in a cocktail glass.

sources.name: Whiskey Sour
sources.method: Shake and strain over cubed ice.
steps: Shake whiskey, lemon, gomme syrup, bitters, and optional egg white.
Strain into a rocks glass over cubed ice.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

sources.name: Moscow Mule
sources.method: Build over ice and stir gently.
steps: Add ice to a rocks glass or lined mule mug.
Combine vodka and ginger beer, then add lime juice.
Stir gently and garnish with a lime slice.

sources.name: Cosmopolitan

ingredients.item: Rose's lime cordial or ¼ fresh lime

sources.method: Combine, shake over ice, and strain.
steps: Combine vodka, triple sec, cranberry, and lime.
Shake over ice.
Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with flamed orange zest.

sources.name: Gin and Tonic
sources.method: Build over plenty of ice; add gin first and fill with tonic without stirring.
steps: Fill a glass about two-thirds with ice.
Add gin, then fill with tonic water.
Do not stir; add a lime or lemon wedge.

sources.name: French 75
sources.method: Build in a flute: combine gin, sugar, and lemon, then top with Champagne.
steps: Add gin, sugar, and lemon juice to a flute.
Fill halfway with Champagne, stir to dissolve sugar, then top with Champagne.
Garnish with a cherry or orange slice.

sources.name: Mimosa
sources.method: Mix both chilled ingredients in the glass and serve cold.
steps: Ensure the Champagne and orange juice are well chilled.
Mix them directly in the flute.
Serve cold with an orange twist.

sources.name: Paloma
sources.method: Salt the rim, add ice and tequila, then grapefruit soda; stir as needed.
steps: Chill a high glass and salt its rim.
Fill with ice and add tequila first.
Fill with grapefruit soda, stir as needed, and add a lemon twist.

sources.name: Aperol Spritz
sources.method: Build over ice in a wine glass and stir gently.
steps: Fill a wine glass with ice.
Build Prosecco, Aperol, and soda water in the glass.
Stir gently and garnish with an orange slice.

sources.name: Lemon Drop
sources.method: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled glass.
steps: Prepare a sugar rim on a chilled cocktail glass.
Add the ingredients to a shaker with ice and shake well.
Strain into the prepared glass.

sources.name: Mai Tai
sources.method: Shake all ingredients with ice and pour into the glass.
sources.garnish: Pineapple spear, mint leaves, and lime peel
steps: Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake and pour into a double rocks or highball glass over shaved or crushed ice.
Garnish with pineapple, mint, and lime peel.

sources.name: Pina Colada
sources.method: Blend all ingredients with ice in an electric blender.
steps: Blend rum, cream of coconut, pineapple juice, and ice in an electric blender.
Pour into a large hurricane glass.
Serve with straws and garnish with a cherry or pineapple wedge.

sources.name: Long Island Iced Tea
sources.method: Build in an ice-filled highball, top with cola, and stir gently.
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Add all ingredients, finishing with cola.
Stir gently and optionally garnish with lemon.

sources.name: Tequila Sunrise
sources.method: Build tequila and orange over crushed ice, then add grenadine without stirring.
steps: Mix tequila and orange juice with ice.
Pour into a highball filled with crushed ice.
Add grenadine so it sinks; do not stir.

sources.name: Bloody Mary
sources.method: Shake with ice and strain over ice.
steps: Combine all ingredients with ice.
Shake and strain into an old-fashioned glass filled with ice.
Garnish with pickled asparagus or celery.

sources.name: Screwdriver
sources.method: Mix in a highball glass with ice.
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Add vodka and orange juice and mix in the glass.
Garnish with an orange slice.

sources.name: White Russian
sources.method: Build over ice, float cream, and stir slowly.
steps: Fill an old-fashioned glass with ice.
Add coffee liqueur and vodka.
Float fresh cream on top and stir slowly.

sources.name: Black Russian
sources.method: Build over ice and stir gently.
sources.garnish: Not specified in the standard preparation
steps: Fill an old-fashioned glass with ice cubes.
Pour in vodka and coffee liqueur.
Stir gently.

sources.name: Irish Coffee
sources.method: Stir whiskey and sugar into hot coffee, then float cream as a distinct layer.
steps: Pour coffee into a preheated mug.
Add whiskey and sugar and stir until dissolved.
Pour chilled cream slowly to form a distinct layer.

sources.name: Mint Julep
sources.method: Crush sugar with mint, fill with crushed ice, then add bourbon.
steps: Crush sugar and mint in the bottom of the glass.
Fill with crushed ice and add bourbon.
Garnish with remaining mint.

sources.name: Sazerac
sources.method: Coat the glass with absinthe; stir the remaining ingredients with ice and strain.
steps: Coat the inside of the glass with absinthe and chill it.
Stir brandy or rye, bitters, and syrup with ice.
Strain into the coated glass and garnish with lemon peel.

sources.name: Boulevardier
sources.method: Stir with ice and strain into a chilled glass.
steps: Pour all ingredients into a mixing glass with ice.
Stir well.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass and garnish with orange zest.

sources.name: Paper Plane
sources.method: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled glass.
sources.garnish: None specified in the IBA preparation
steps: Pour equal ingredients into a shaker.
Shake well with ice.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

sources.name: Penicillin
sources.method: Muddle ginger, shake the remaining base with ice, double-strain, and float Islay whisky.
steps: Muddle ginger in a shaker.
Add blended Scotch, lemon, and honey syrup; shake with ice.
Double-strain into an ice-filled old-fashioned glass.
Float the Islay whisky on top and garnish with candied ginger.

sources.name: Last Word
sources.method: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled glass.
steps: Add equal ingredients to a shaker.
Shake with ice.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

sources.name: Aviation
sources.method: Shake or stir with ice and strain.
steps: Combine the ingredients with ice.
Shake or stir, then strain into a cocktail glass.
Garnish with a cherry.

sources.name: Gimlet
sources.method: Mix and serve chilled.
steps: Mix gin and sweetened lime juice.
Serve chilled in a cocktail glass.
Garnish with a lime slice.

sources.name: Tom Collins
sources.method: Build gin, lemon, and syrup over ice, top with soda, and garnish.
steps: Add gin, lemon juice, and simple syrup to an ice-filled Collins glass.
Top with soda water.
Garnish with lemon and cherry.

sources.name: Sidecar
sources.method: Shake with ice and strain into a sugar-rimmed glass.
steps: Prepare a sugar rim on the cocktail glass.
Shake cognac, triple sec, and lemon juice with ice.
Strain into the glass and garnish with a lemon twist.

sources.name: Bees Knees
sources.method: Combine in a mixing tin, shake, strain into a chilled glass, and garnish.
steps: Add gin, honey syrup, lemon juice, and orange juice to a mixing tin.
Shake.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass and garnish with lemon peel.

sources.name: Corpse Reviver No. 2
sources.method: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled glass.
steps: Add gin, lemon, Cointreau, Lillet Blanc, and absinthe to a mixer with ice.
Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with orange zest.

sources.name: Vesper
sources.method: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled glass.
steps: Add gin, vodka, and Lillet Blanc to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with lemon zest.

sources.name: Dirty Martini
sources.method: Stir with ice and strain.
steps: Stir gin or vodka, vermouth, and olive juice with ice in a Boston shaker.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with a green olive.

sources.name: Pornstar Martini
sources.method: Shake the cocktail ingredients with ice and strain; serve Champagne alongside.
sources.garnish: Passion fruit half dusted with vanilla sugar; Champagne sidecar
steps: Add vodka, Passoã, passion fruit purée, and vanilla sugar to a mixing glass with ice.
Shake well and strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with a vanilla-sugar-dusted passion fruit half and serve Champagne in a chilled shot glass alongside.

sources.name: French Martini
sources.method: Shake with ice, chill, and strain.
steps: Combine vodka, Chambord, and pineapple juice with ice in a shaker.
Shake until chilled and strain into a martini or cocktail glass.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

sources.name: Amaretto Sour
sources.method: Mix and serve over ice.
sources.garnish: Cherry and orange or lemon wedge
steps: Mix amaretto and sour mix.
Serve over ice in an old-fashioned glass.
Garnish with a cherry and orange or lemon wedge.

sources.name: Dark n Stormy
sources.method: Pour ginger beer into an ice-filled highball glass and float the rum on top.
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Pour in the ginger beer.
Float the rum on top and garnish with a lime wedge.

sources.name: Cuba Libre
sources.method: Build over ice, rum first, then cola; squeeze and drop in lime.
steps: Rub the lime around the rim and fill the highball with ice.
Add rum, then fill with Coca-Cola.
Squeeze the lime into the drink and drop it in.

sources.name: Caipirinha
sources.method: Muddle lime and sugar, add cracked ice and cachaça, then stir gently.
steps: Place lime and sugar in the glass and muddle gently.
Fill with cracked ice and add cachaça.
Stir gently to combine.

sources.name: Jungle Bird
sources.method: Shake with ice and strain into a rocks glass filled with ice.
steps: Add rum, Campari, pineapple juice, lime juice, and demerara syrup to a shaker with ice.
Shake.
Strain into an ice-filled rocks glass and garnish with a pineapple wedge.

sources.name: Painkiller
sources.method: Shake and serve on the rocks.
steps: Shake rum, pineapple juice, cream of coconut, and orange juice.
Serve over ice.
Sprinkle generously with fresh nutmeg.

sources.name: Hemingway Daiquiri
sources.method: Shake all ingredients with ice.
steps: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice.
Shake and serve straight up in a cocktail glass.

sources.name: Americano
sources.method: Build directly over ice and add soda.
steps: Fill an old-fashioned glass with ice.
Add Campari and red vermouth.
Add soda and garnish with half an orange slice.

sources.name: Hugo Spritz
sources.method: Gently muddle mint and lime, then build over ice and stir gently.
sources.garnish: Mint sprig and lime slice or wheel
steps: Gently muddle mint and lime in a large wine glass.
Fill with ice and add elderflower liqueur.
Add Prosecco followed by sparkling water.
Stir gently and garnish with mint and lime.

sources.name: Bellini
sources.method: Gently roll with ice, then strain.
steps: Put peach purée and Prosecco in a mixing glass with ice.
Gently roll rather than shake.
Strain into a champagne glass.

sources.name: Kir Royale
sources.method: Add cassis first, pour Champagne, and stir until pale.
steps: Pour crème de cassis into a champagne glass.
Add Champagne.
Stir until the drink is pale and serve cold.

sources.name: Southside
sources.method: Shake well with ice and double-strain into a chilled glass.
steps: Add gin, lemon juice, simple syrup, mint, and optional egg white to a shaker.
Shake well with ice.
Double-strain into a chilled cocktail glass and garnish with mint sprigs.

sources.name: Clover Club

ingredients.item: Egg white (or 20 ml aquafaba or 4 drops cocktail foamer)

sources.method: Dry-shake to emulsify, add ice, shake, and serve straight up.
steps: Add gin, lemon juice, raspberry syrup, and egg white to a shaker.
Dry-shake to emulsify.
Add ice, shake, and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

sources.name: Brandy Alexander
sources.method: Shake with ice and strain.
steps: Combine cognac, crème de cacao, and cream with ice.
Shake and strain into a cocktail glass.

sources.name: Grasshopper
sources.method: Shake briskly with ice and strain into a chilled glass.
steps: Add crème de menthe, crème de cacao, and cream to a shaker.
Shake briskly with ice.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

sources.name: Sex on the Beach
sources.method: Build all ingredients in an ice-filled highball glass.
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add vodka, peach schnapps, orange juice, and cranberry juice.
Garnish with an orange slice.

sources.name: Blue Hawaiian
sources.method: Shake with ice and strain.
steps: Combine the ingredients with ice.
Shake and strain into a highball.
Garnish with a cherry and pineapple.

sources.name: Zombie
sources.method: Pulse-blend all ingredients with cracked ice for a few seconds.
steps: Add all ingredients and 170 g cracked ice to an electric blender.
Pulse-blend for a few seconds.
Serve in a tall tumbler over ice and garnish with mint leaves.

sources.name: Godfather
sources.method: Pour directly into an ice-filled glass and stir gently.
steps: Fill an old-fashioned glass with ice.
Pour in the Scotch whisky and amaretto.
Stir gently.

sources.name: Rusty Nail
sources.method: Pour directly into an ice-filled glass and stir gently.
steps: Fill an old-fashioned glass with ice.
Pour in the Scotch whisky and Drambuie.
Stir gently and optionally garnish with orange peel.

sources.name: Rob Roy
sources.method: Stir with ice and strain into a chilled glass; it may also be served on the rocks.
sources.garnish: Two maraschino cherries on a skewer or a lemon twist
steps: Add Scotch, sweet vermouth, and bitters to a mixing glass with ice.
Stir and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with cherries or a lemon twist.

sources.name: Vieux Carre
sources.method: Stir with ice and strain into a chilled glass.
sources.garnish: Orange zest and a maraschino cherry
steps: Add rye, cognac, sweet vermouth, Bénédictine, and bitters to a mixing glass with ice.
Stir and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with orange zest and a maraschino cherry.

sources.name: New York Sour
sources.method: Shake the base with ice, strain over ice, and float red wine on top.
sources.garnish: Lemon or orange zest and cherry
steps: Shake whiskey, syrup, lemon juice, and egg white vigorously with ice.
Strain into a chilled rocks glass filled with ice.
Float red wine on top and garnish with zest and cherry.

sources.name: Seven and Seven
sources.method: Pour whiskey into an ice-filled glass, fill with 7 Up, and stir lightly.
steps: Fill a Collins glass with ice.
Pour in Seagram's Seven Crown whiskey.
Fill with 7 Up and stir lightly.
Optionally garnish with a lemon or lime wedge.

sources.name: Kamikaze
sources.method: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain, and garnish.
steps: Add vodka, triple sec, and lime juice to a shaker with ice.
Shake and strain into a cocktail glass.
Garnish with a lime slice.

sources.name: Greyhound
sources.method: Shake in a cocktail shaker and strain into a highball glass.
steps: Add gin or vodka and grapefruit juice to a shaker with ice.
Shake and strain into a highball glass.
Garnish with a lime or lemon twist.

sources.name: Salty Dog
sources.method: Combine and serve in a salt-rimmed glass.
steps: Salt the rim of a highball glass.
Combine gin or vodka with grapefruit juice.
Serve in the salt-rimmed glass.

sources.name: Bay Breeze
sources.method: Build all ingredients in an ice-filled highball glass.
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Build in the vodka, cranberry juice, and pineapple juice.
Garnish with a lime wedge.

sources.name: Sea Breeze
sources.method: Build all ingredients in an ice-filled highball glass.
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add vodka, cranberry juice, and grapefruit juice.
Garnish with a lime wedge.

sources.name: Blue Lagoon
sources.method: Shake vodka and rum with crushed ice in a shaker, then build the drink and pour curaçao through it.
steps: Shake vodka and Malibu with crushed ice in a shaker.
Pour into the glass and add lemonade.
Pour blue curaçao down the inside of the glass for the layered effect.

sources.name: AMF
sources.method: Build on ice and top with soda.
steps: Fill a highball with ice.
Pour the equal spirit measures and sour mix over the ice.
Top with 7-Up or citrus soda.

sources.name: Alabama Slammer
sources.method: Pour all ingredients, then shake with ice and strain.
steps: Pour the spirits and orange juice into a shaker.
Shake with ice, then strain into a shot glass or cordial.

sources.name: Jägerbomb
sources.method: Drop the Jägermeister into the energy drink and drink quickly.
steps: Fill a glass with energy drink.
Pour Jägermeister into a shot glass, drop it into the energy drink, and drink quickly.

sources.name: Arnold Palmer
sources.method: Combine the iced tea and lemonade.
steps: Combine three parts unsweetened iced tea with one part lemonade.
